description: This file implements timezone and time conversion functions using ICU libraries, providing functionality to explode and implode time values, handle timezones, and get current time in different formats.

methods.name: InitializeTimeZone
methods.description: Initializes a timezone in ICU timezone cache from a string name.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes ICU and timezone cache; called once.

methods.name: UDateToSbTime
methods.description: Converts ICU UDate to SbTime (milliseconds since epoch).

methods.name: SbTimeToUDate
methods.description: Converts SbTime to ICU UDate, lossy conversion.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneId
methods.description: Retrieves cached ICU timezone ID for a given EzTimeZone.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplode
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT to exploded time components in specified timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueExplode
methods.description: Converts EzTimeValue to exploded time components in specified timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplode
methods.description: Converts exploded time components to EzTimeT in specified timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueImplode
methods.description: Converts exploded time components to EzTimeValue.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeLocal
methods.description: Implodes exploded time in local timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeUTC
methods.description: Implodes exploded time in UTC timezone.
